content.title: Justin Rose Honors His Wife Kate on the Course and it's the Sweetest Thing Ever
content.text: Justin Rose and his wife, Kate, have been married since 2006.Apr 12, 2026 4:40 PM EDTJustin Rose talks during the presentation ceremony with his wife, Kate Rose on the eighteenth green during The Rose Ladies Series at Bearwood Lakes Golf Club on April 28, 2022 in Wokingham, England. Alex Burstow/Getty ImagesKey PointsJustin Rose is competing for his first Masters win, supported by wife Kate Rose.He plays with no. 99 golf balls because nine is Kate's favorite.The couple has two children and they co-founded the Kate and Justin Rose Foundation. Justin Rose is competing in The Masters and is in contention to win his very first green jacket. The pro golfer has the support of his wife, Kate Rose (née Phillips), whom he married in 2006. One thing that some people may not know about Justin, 45, is that he honors his wife in the sweetest way whenever he golfs. According to Town & Country, Justin plays with no. 99 golf balls because nine is Kate’s favorite number. Per the report, Justin says the double nine is just “double the luck.” Justin and Kate met more than two decades ago when she worked at IMG. They got married in December 2006 and have two kids together—a son named Leo born in 2009, and a daughter named Lottie, who was born in 2012. In 2009, the Roses founded the Kate and Justin Rose Foundation, which “aims to help fight childhood hunger in the Orlando area and also provides impoverished children with education and experiences,” according to Golf Monthly. Justin has never won a Masters, though he’s come close a handful of times. He’s won multiple titles, including the 2013 US Open, and he even has a gold medal from the 2016 Olympic Games. About the authorEffie Orfanides is a trending news writer for Parade. With more than two decades of experience, she focuses on celebrity news, celebrity relationships, music, and reality television.
